summary_1line: Bhishma recounts the tale of the bird Pujani and King Brahmadatta debating trust, revenge, and whether enmity can ever truly end.

image_candidates.scene_text: The grieving bird Pujani returns to the palace and finds her chick lying dead on the ground, killed by the playful infant prince.
In fierce vengeance, the bird Pujani swoops down and pierces the young prince’s eyes with her talons.
The bird and King Brahmadatta face each other in the palace chamber as they argue about trust, fate, and the permanence of hostility.
